skill.summary: 深入了解瑞士高端巧克力品牌Lindt Spruengli的历史、商业模式、竞争策略及市场成长关键因素。

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release introducing an in-depth overview of Lindt & Sprüngli’s history, growth, and business strategies.
- Covers key milestones from 1845 origins to becoming a global luxury chocolate leader.
